title: Doctor document
description: What `recon doctor` found about this machine: the environment it recorded, and one check per thing a project needs (the project itself, a compiler, a linker, the inputs).

ok.description: False when any check is not ok. This is the field to branch on.

environment.description: Named values about the machine and the project, for a bug report.

hint.description: What to do about it, when there is something to do.
